text: Computer vision is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating several objects in one image at the same time. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging, and shopping apps. It is also very important for self-driving cars, because these vehicles need to recognise roads, signs, and people to travel safely.
